metadata.name: Prevalence of undernourishment (% of population)
metadata.sourceNote: Prevalence of undernourishment is the percentage of the population whose habitual food consumption is insufficient to provide the dietary energy levels that are required to maintain a normal active and healthy life. Data showing as 2.5 may signify a prevalence of undernourishment below 2.5%.
metadata.sourceOrganization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: http://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#home
